test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A dozen pairs of jeans costing ₹3,520 are available at a discount of 35%. How many pairs of jeans can be purchased for ₹572?
solution:
**Given:**

12 pairs cost = ₹3520

Discount = 35%

Budget = ₹572

**Formula used:**

Price per pair = Total Cost ÷ Number of pairs

Selling price = Marked price × (1 − Discount%)

Number of pairs purchasable = Budget ÷ Selling price per pair

**Calculation:**

Price per pair = 3520 ÷ 12

⇒ Price per pair = 293.33

Selling price after 35% discount = 293.33 × 0.65

⇒ Selling price = 190.66

Pairs purchasable = 572 ÷ 190.66

⇒ Pairs purchasable ≈ 3

**∴ A person can buy 3 pairs of jeans.**
